# Staged for iTerm2-Color-Schemes

Fovea's themes in the YAML format of [iTerm2-Color-Schemes](https://github.com/mbadolato/iTerm2-Color-Schemes), ready to
propose upstream. Nothing here has been submitted. To submit:

1. Fork https://github.com/mbadolato/iTerm2-Color-Schemes and clone the fork.
2. Copy `yaml/*.yml` from this directory into the fork's `yaml/` directory.
3. Check that each theme generates:

   ```sh
   cd tools
   python gen.py -s "Fovea Day"
   python gen.py -s "Fovea Dusk"
   python gen.py -s "Fovea Night"
   ```

4. Commit only the YAML files, noting AI involvement in the commit message as the project's
   `AGENTS.md` asks, and open a pull request with [`PULL_REQUEST.md`](PULL_REQUEST.md) as the
   description.
